blurb.en: Choose the right picture, then write names, numbers and times on a form.
blurb.vi: Chọn đúng bức tranh, rồi viết tên, số và giờ vào phiếu.

o'clock.def: We say it after a time with no minutes, like 3:00.

half past.def: Thirty minutes after the hour, like 6:30.
half past.ex: We have lunch at *half past* twelve.

quarter past.def: Fifteen minutes after the hour, like 9:15.
quarter past.ex: The bus comes at *quarter past* eight.

phone number.def: The numbers you press to call a person.
phone number.ex: My mum's *phone number* is on the fridge.

age.def: How many years old you are.
age.ex: My *age* is eight. I'm in Grade 3.

form.def: A paper with lines. You write your name and other details on it.
form.ex: Please write your phone number on the *form*.

first name.def: What your friends and teachers call you, like Lucy or Tuan.

surname.def: Your family name. People in your family often have it too.

spell.def: To say the letters of a word one by one, in the right order.

usually.def: On most days, but maybe not every day.
usually.ex: I *usually* walk to school, but today I'm going by bus.

today.def: This day. Not yesterday and not tomorrow.
today.ex: *Today* my lesson starts at five o'clock.

instead.def: In the place of another thing.
instead.ex: There isn't any juice, so I'll have milk *instead*.

change your mind.def: To have a new idea and choose something different.
change your mind.ex: You can *change your mind* and choose the kite.

title.vi: Đáp án đến sau từ No

scenes.head: Listen to Nam and his grandpa. What does Nam's new neighbour do?
scenes.html:
Grandpa: Nam, is your new neighbour a doctor?
Nam: *No*, Grandpa. He works at the hospital, but he isn't a doctor. He's *a cook* in the hospital kitchen.
Grandpa: A cook! And his wife?
Nam: She drives a bus.

audio.head: Listen to Nam and his grandpa.
lines: Nam, is your new neighbour a doctor?
No, Grandpa. He works at the hospital, but he isn't a doctor. He's a cook in the hospital kitchen.

steps.en: Three jobs are in the talk: a *doctor*, a *cook* and a *bus driver*. In Part 1 you hear all three pictures.
steps.vi: Có ba nghề trong đoạn hội thoại: bác sĩ, đầu bếp và tài xế xe buýt. Ở Phần 1, em sẽ nghe thấy cả ba bức tranh.

steps.en: Grandpa guesses *doctor*. Nam says *No*. Listen to the words AFTER *No*.
steps.vi: Ông đoán là bác sĩ. Nam nói *No*. Hãy nghe những từ SAU từ *No*.

steps.en: The question is about the neighbour, not his wife. He is *a cook*.
steps.vi: Câu hỏi nói về người hàng xóm, không phải vợ của chú ấy. Chú ấy là đầu bếp.

scenes.head: Listen to Sophie and her mum. What time will Sophie go to bed tonight?
scenes.html:
Mum: Sophie, it's eight o'clock. Time for bed!
Sophie: But Mum, it's a full moon tonight. Can I see it?
Mum: You *usually* go to bed at eight. But *tonight* is special. Go to bed at *half past eight*.
Sophie: Thank you! The moon comes up at quarter past eight.

audio.head: Listen to Sophie and her mum.
lines: Sophie, it's eight o'clock. Time for bed!
But Mum, it's a full moon tonight. Can I see it?
You usually go to bed at eight. But tonight is special. Go to bed at half past eight.
Thank you! The moon comes up at quarter past eight.

steps.en: *Usually* tells you what happens on most days. The question asks about *tonight*.
steps.vi: *Usually* cho em biết điều thường xảy ra vào hầu hết các ngày. Câu hỏi hỏi về *tối nay*.

steps.en: Three times are said: eight o'clock, quarter past eight and half past eight.
steps.vi: Có ba giờ được nói: tám giờ, tám giờ mười lăm và tám giờ rưỡi.

steps.en: Tonight Sophie goes to bed at *half past eight*. That is 8:30.
steps.vi: Tối nay Sophie đi ngủ lúc tám giờ rưỡi, tức là 8:30.

scenes.head:
Listen to Raj and the football coach. Complete the form.
FOOTBALL CLUB
First name: Raj (example)
Surname: ________
Phone number: ________
scenes.html:
Coach: Hello! What's your first name?
Raj: Raj. R-A-J.
Coach: And what's your surname?
Raj: Sharma. *S-H-A-R-M-A*.
Coach: Thank you. What's your phone number?
Raj: It's *five three eight two nine four one*.
Coach: Five three eight, two nine four one?
Raj: Yes, that's right.

audio.head: Listen to Raj and the football coach.
lines: Thank you. What's your phone number?
It's five three eight two nine four one.
Five three eight, two nine four one?

steps.en: When a name is *spelled*, write every letter you hear: S-H-A-R-M-A is *Sharma*.
steps.vi: Khi một cái tên được đánh vần, hãy viết từng chữ cái em nghe được: S-H-A-R-M-A là *Sharma*.

steps.en: A *phone number* is said one number at a time. Write the numbers: 538 2941.
steps.vi: Số điện thoại được đọc từng số một. Hãy viết các con số: 538 2941.

steps.en: The coach says the number again to *check* it. Use this to check your answer too!
steps.vi: Huấn luyện viên nhắc lại số điện thoại để kiểm tra. Em cũng hãy dùng lúc này để kiểm tra đáp án của mình!

end.en: Great listening! You found the answers after No, usually and a changed mind.
end.vi: Nghe giỏi lắm! Em đã tìm được đáp án sau từ No, usually và khi ai đó đổi ý.

v.q: Where is Jack's football?
whys: Mum looked in the garden, and the ball wasn't there.
Jack says the ball is not in the car.
v.hint: Two places are wrong. Listen for No and Not.
v.worked: Jack finds it: "Oh, look! It's *behind the sofa*."

stim.head: Listen to Jack and his mum.
lines: Mum, where's my football? Is it in the garden?
No, it isn't. I looked there. Is it in the car?
Not in the car. Oh, look! It's behind the sofa.

v.q: Where is Amira going this afternoon?
whys: Grandpa guesses the library, but Amira says no.
Amira went to the park yesterday, not today.
v.hint: Grandpa guesses first. Is his guess right?
v.worked: Amira says "No, Grandpa. I'm going to *the swimming pool*."

stim.head: Listen to Amira and her grandpa.
lines: Amira, do you want to go to the library this afternoon?
No, Grandpa. I'm going to the swimming pool with my brother.
We went to the park yesterday.

v.q: What will Tuan have for lunch?
whys: There aren't any noodles today.
Tuan had rice yesterday, so he wants something different.
v.hint: Tuan asks for one thing, Dad offers another. Which one does Tuan get?
v.worked: Tuan asks "Can I have *a sandwich*?" and Dad says "OK. A cheese sandwich for you."

stim.head: Listen to Tuan and his dad.
lines: Dad, can I have noodles for lunch?
Sorry, we haven't got any noodles. What about rice?
We had rice yesterday. Can I have a sandwich?
OK. A cheese sandwich for you.

v.q: What will Grace drink with her breakfast?
whys: Grace asks for juice, but there isn't any.
Grace says she doesn't want water.
v.hint: Grace changes her mind. Then there is a problem. Listen to the end.
v.worked: There isn't any juice, so Grace says "Then *milk*, please."

stim.head: Listen to Grace and her mum.
lines: Grace, do you want milk with your breakfast?
Yes, please. Hmm, no. Can I have juice?
There isn't any juice. Sorry! Water or milk?
Then milk, please. I don't want water.

v.q: What time is Ethan's swimming lesson today?
whys: Four o'clock is the usual time, not today's time.
Half past four is when Ethan stops playing football.
v.hint: Listen for usually and today. The question says today.
v.worked: Mum says "It's usually at four. But *today* the pool is busy. So it's at *five o'clock*."

stim.head: Listen to Ethan and his mum.
lines: Mum, my swimming lesson is at four o'clock, isn't it?
It's usually at four. But today the pool is busy. So it's at five o'clock.
Five! Can I play football until half past four?

v.q: What time will Ngoc's family have dinner today?
whys: Seven o'clock is when they usually eat.
Half past seven is when the fun run starts.
v.hint: Three times are said. Which one is for dinner tonight?
v.worked: Dad says "We usually eat at seven... *So let's eat at six*."

stim.head: Listen to Ngoc and her dad.
lines: Dad, are we having dinner at seven o'clock?
We usually eat at seven. But tonight there's a fun run in our neighbourhood at half past seven. So let's eat at six.

v.q: What does Lucy's friend's mum do?
whys: Mum guesses teacher, but Lucy says no.
The farmer is her friend's grandad, not her mum.
v.hint: Listen to the words after No. Who is the farmer?
v.worked: Lucy says "No, she isn't. She's *a vet*. She looks after animals."

stim.head: Listen to Lucy and her mum.
lines: Lucy, what does your new friend's mum do? Is she a teacher?
No, she isn't. She's a vet. She looks after animals.
Oh! I thought she was a farmer.
No, her grandad is a farmer.

v.q: What is on Ethan's new T-shirt?
whys: The rocket is on his brother's T-shirt.
Ethan says the stars are on his hat.
v.hint: Grandma guesses twice. Listen to what Ethan says about HIS T-shirt.
v.worked: Ethan says "*Mine has a big planet* with rings."

stim.head: Listen to Ethan and his grandma.
lines: Ethan, I like your new T-shirt. Is that a rocket on it?
No, Grandma. My brother's T-shirt has a rocket. Mine has a big planet with rings.
No, the stars are on my hat!

blurb.en: Practise times, prices and days, then the traps, then short form lines.
blurb.vi: Luyện nghe giờ, giá tiền và các ngày, rồi các bẫy, rồi điền phiếu ngắn.

title.vi: Giờ, giá tiền và các ngày

v.q: What time does the school concert start?
whys: Half past five is when Grandma should come.
Half past seven is when the concert finishes.
v.hint: Three times are said. Which one goes with the word start?
v.worked: Sophie says "It *starts at six o'clock*."

stim.head: Listen to Sophie and her grandma.
lines: Grandma, can you come to my school concert on Friday?
Of course! What time does it start?
It starts at six o'clock. Please come at half past five. It finishes at half past seven.

v.q: What time does the space show start?
whys: Ten o'clock is when they get to the museum.
Twelve o'clock is lunchtime.
v.hint: Listen for the word show. Quarter past means 15 minutes after.
v.worked: Dad says "The space show *starts at quarter past ten*." That is 10:15.

stim.head: Listen to Raj and his dad.
lines: Dad, what time are we going to the science museum?
We'll get there at ten o'clock. The space show starts at quarter past ten.
We'll have lunch at twelve o'clock.

v.q: How much is the chocolate cake?
whys: Two pounds is the price of the lemon cake.
One pound is the price of a bag of biscuits.
v.hint: Three prices are said. Listen for the word chocolate.
v.worked: Ngoc asks about the chocolate cake and Dad says "It's *three pounds*."

stim.head: Listen to Ngoc and her dad at the school fair.
lines: Dad, look at the cakes! How much is the chocolate cake?
It's three pounds. The lemon cake is two pounds.

v.q: How much is a ticket for children?
whys: Eight pounds is the price for grown-ups.
Two pounds is the price of a map.
v.hint: Jack is a child. Listen for the word children.
v.worked: Mum says "A ticket *for children is four pounds*."

stim.head: Listen to Jack and his mum at the museum.
lines: Mum, how much are the tickets for the museum?
A ticket for children is four pounds. For grown-ups, it's eight pounds.
Can I buy a map too?
Yes. A map is two pounds.

v.q: Which day is the football match?
whys: Tuesday is a practice day, not the match.
Thursday is a practice day, not the match.
v.hint: Practice and match are different. Listen for the word match.
v.worked: The coach says "*The match is on Saturday*."

stim.head: Listen to Tuan and his football coach.
lines: Coach, when is the football match?
We practise on Tuesday and Thursday. The match is on Saturday.

v.q: Which day will Amira go to Grandma's house?
whys: Mum says not on Monday.
On Friday, Grandma comes to Amira's house.
v.hint: Listen for not. Who goes to whose house?
v.worked: Mum says "*We're going on Wednesday*, after school."

stim.head: Listen to Amira and her mum.
lines: Mum, are we visiting Grandma on Monday?
Not on Monday. We're going on Wednesday, after school.
On Friday, Grandma is coming to our house!

title.en: Traps: No, usually and a changed mind
title.vi: Bẫy: No, usually và khi đổi ý

v.q: Where does Jack's cousin live?
whys: Grandpa guesses the city, but Jack says no.
The farm is near the sea, not near the mountains.
v.hint: Grandpa guesses. Listen to Jack's answer after No.
v.worked: Jack says "No, Grandpa. *She lives on a farm*."

stim.head: Listen to Jack and his grandpa.
lines: Jack, does your cousin live in the city?
No, Grandpa. She lives on a farm. She's got ten goats!
Is the farm near the mountains?

v.q: Which planet does Grace like best?
whys: Grace says Mars is nice, but it isn't her favourite.
Earth is our home, but Grace likes another planet best.
v.hint: Listen for best and favourite.
v.worked: Grace says "*I like Saturn best*. It's got beautiful rings."

stim.head: Listen to Grace and her teacher.
lines: Grace, is Mars your favourite planet?
No, it isn't. Mars is nice and red, but I like Saturn best. It's got beautiful rings.
Earth is our home. But Saturn is my favourite.

v.q: How will Raj go to school today?
whys: Raj usually walks, but not today.
Dad needs the car for work today.
v.hint: The question says today. Is today a usual day?
v.worked: Dad says "I need the car for work. *Take the bus* with your friends."

stim.head: Listen to Raj and his dad.
lines: Raj, are you walking to school today?
I usually walk, Dad. But it's raining a lot today. Can you take me in the car?
Sorry, I need the car for work. Take the bus with your friends.

v.q: What will Ngoc have for breakfast today?
whys: Ngoc usually has noodles, but she wants something different today.
There isn't any rice.
v.hint: Usually is not today. Is there a problem with the next idea?
v.worked: Mum says "*Have a mango* with some yoghurt", and Ngoc says OK.

stim.head: Listen to Ngoc and her mum.
lines: Ngoc, do you want noodles for breakfast?
I usually have noodles. But today I want something different. Can I have rice?
We haven't got any rice. Have a mango with some yoghurt.

v.q: What will Ethan make for Grandma's birthday?
whys: Ethan made a card last year, so he wants a new idea.
Ethan says he can't make cakes.
v.hint: Ethan has a new idea. Listen for I'll.
v.worked: Ethan says "I know. *I'll draw a picture* of her garden."

stim.head: Listen to Ethan and his mum.
lines: Mum, I want to make a card for Grandma's birthday.
You made a card last year. What about a cake?
I can't make cakes! I know. I'll draw a picture of her garden.

v.q: What will Amira grow in her pot?
whys: The pot is too small for carrots.
Strawberries are for the summer, not now.
v.hint: Amira changes her mind. What does she choose now?
v.worked: Amira says "Cress grows fast. *I'll grow cress*."

stim.head: Listen to Amira and her dad.
lines: Dad, I want to grow carrots in my pot.
The pot is too small for carrots. What about strawberries?
Hmm. Cress grows fast. I'll grow cress, and we can grow strawberries in the summer.

title.en: Spell it, say it, write it
title.vi: Đánh vần, đọc số và viết

v.q: Listen and write Lucy's surname.
v.hint: Write every letter. Count the letters at the end of the name.
v.worked: Lucy spells it: "*W-E-B-B*". So the surname is *Webb*.

stim.head: Listen to Lucy and her teacher.
lines: Lucy, I'm writing the names for the school choir. What's your surname?
No, there are two Bs. W-E-B-B.

v.q: Listen and write the cat's name.
v.hint: Write one letter for each letter you hear.
v.worked: Tuan spells the name: "*B-I-N-G-O*".

stim.head: Listen to Tuan and the vet.
lines: B-I-N-G-O. Hello, Bingo! What a lovely cat.

v.q: Listen and write the phone number.
ans: six four nine three one two eight
v.hint: Write one number for each number you hear. Sophie says it again: check.
v.worked: Mum says "*six four nine three one two eight*". That is 649 3128.

stim.head: Listen to Sophie and her mum.
lines: Mum, I want to call Grandma. What's her phone number?
It's six four nine three one two eight.
Six four nine, three one two eight?

v.q: Listen and write the phone number.
ans: five one nine four four two seven
v.hint: Write the numbers in the same order. Two numbers can be the same.
v.worked: The coach says "*five one nine four four two seven*". That is 519 4427.

stim.head: Listen to Nam and his football coach.
lines: Nam, if you can't come to practice, please call me.
Can I have your phone number, Coach?
It's five one nine four four two seven.
Five one nine, four four two seven. Thanks!

v.q: Listen and complete the form.
v.hint: Two numbers are said about age. Which one is Raj's age?
v.worked: Raj says "*I'm nine*." The helper says "The show starts at *half past two*."

stim.head: Listen to Raj and a helper at the science museum.
lines: Hello! Do you want a ticket for the star show?
Children under eight need a grown-up. You're fine. The show starts at half past two.

v.q: Listen and complete the form.
v.hint: The form is about Ngoc's brother, not Ngoc. Quarter past means 15 minutes after.
v.worked: Ngoc says "*He's six*." The teacher says the class starts at *quarter past four*.

stim.head: Listen to Ngoc and her teacher.
lines: Ngoc, your brother wants to join the art class. How old is he?
Good. The class starts at quarter past four, after school.
Quarter past four. I'll tell him!

blurb.en: Listening Part 1 and Part 3, just like the real exam.

whys: Grandma guesses the park, but Ethan says no.
The cinema is next Saturday, not last Saturday.
v.hint: Grandma guesses first. Listen to Ethan's answer after No.
v.worked: Ethan says "No, Grandma. *We went to the science museum*."

stim.head: Listen to Ethan and his grandma.

No, Grandma. We went to the science museum. I saw a space rover!

v.q: Where is Lucy's new sports club?
whys: The sports centre is closed this month.
Lucy says it's too cold in the park.

stim.head: Listen to Lucy and her dad.
lines: Lucy, is your new sports club at the sports centre?
No, Dad. It's closed this month. The club is at my school.
No, it's too cold in the park.

v.q: What did Ethan have for lunch?
whys: Ethan left his sandwiches in the car.
Dad had the chips, not Ethan.
v.hint: Two people have lunch. Listen for what Ethan had.
v.worked: Ethan says "*I had pasta* in the café."

stim.head: Listen to Ethan and his grandma.
lines: Did you have your sandwiches for lunch?
No! I left them in the car. So I had pasta in the café.

v.q: What job does Lucy's coach do?
whys: Dad guesses teacher, but Lucy says no.
The police officer is the coach's brother.
v.hint: Listen for No. Who is the police officer?
v.worked: Lucy says "No, she isn't. *She's a nurse* at the hospital."

stim.head: Listen to Lucy and her dad.
lines: Is your coach a teacher at your school?
No, she isn't. She's a nurse at the hospital.
Oh. I thought she was a police officer.

v.q: Which poster did Ethan buy?
whys: The moon poster was too big.
The poster of the stars is his sister's.
v.hint: Ethan talks about three posters. Which one is his?
v.worked: The moon poster was too big, "So *I got a rocket poster*."

stim.head: Listen to Ethan and his grandma.
lines: Did you buy something in the shop?
Yes, a poster. The moon poster was too big. So I got a rocket poster.
She got a poster of the stars.

v.q: What will Lucy have for dinner tonight?
whys: They had rice and chicken yesterday.
There aren't any noodles.
v.hint: Lucy asks for something. Can she have it?
v.worked: Dad says "What about *fish and chips*?" and Lucy says "Yes, please!"

stim.head: Listen to Lucy and her dad.
lines: Do you want rice and chicken for dinner tonight?
We had that yesterday. Can we have noodles?
There aren't any noodles. What about fish and chips?

v.q: What time will Raj leave home tomorrow?
whys: Half past seven is when the bus usually comes, but tomorrow is different.
Seven o'clock is when Raj has to be at school.
v.hint: The question says leave home. Which time goes with home?
v.worked: Raj has to be at school at seven, so Mum says "So *leave home at quarter to seven*."

stim.head: Listen to Raj and his mum.
lines: Raj, the bus usually comes at half past seven.
But tomorrow is our trip. We have to be at school at seven o'clock.
So leave home at quarter to seven.

v.q: Where did Ngoc find the little cat?
whys: Ngoc heard the cat in the garden, but it was not there. It was up on the roof.
Ngoc says the tree was empty.
v.hint: Hearing and finding are different. Where was the cat?
v.worked: Ngoc says "But *it was up on our roof*!"

stim.head: Listen to Ngoc and her grandpa.
lines: Ngoc, did you find the cat in the garden?
I heard it in the garden. But it was up on our roof!

v.q: Where will Raj sleep on the trip?
whys: It's too cold at night to sleep in tents.

v.hint: Mum guesses twice. Listen for the reason in Raj's answers.

stim.head: Listen to Raj and his mum.
lines: Are you going to sleep in tents?
No, it's too cold at night. We're sleeping in wooden huts.

whys: Nine o'clock is the usual opening time, not Sunday's.
Ten o'clock is when the vet opens today.

whys: The box was for last night.
Mum says the cat can't sleep on Ngoc's bed.

lines: Did the cat sleep in a box last night?
Yes, in the kitchen. Tonight she's going to sleep in a basket.

Listen to Nam and a receptionist at the sports centre. Complete the form.
JUNIOR SWIMMING LESSONS
First name: Nam (example)
1 Surname: ________
2 Phone number: ________
3 Lesson time on Saturday: ________
lines: Hello. I want to join the swimming lessons, please.
Great. Can I have your first name?

JUNIOR SWIMMING LESSONS

items.en: Part 1: look at the three pictures first. You will hear *all three*, so listen for the one that answers the question.
items.vi: Phần 1: nhìn ba bức tranh trước. Em sẽ nghe thấy cả ba, nên hãy nghe xem tranh nào trả lời đúng câu hỏi.
example: You hear: the *park*? No. The *museum*. The *cinema* is next week.

items.en: Someone guesses and the other person says *No*. The right answer comes AFTER *No*.
items.vi: Một người đoán và người kia nói *No*. Đáp án đúng đến SAU từ *No*.
example: Is it a rocket? *No*, it's a *planet*.
Is he a doctor? *No*, he's a *cook*.

items.en: *Usually* is about most days. Listen for *today*, *tonight* or *tomorrow* and check the question.
items.vi: *Usually* nói về hầu hết các ngày. Hãy nghe các từ *today*, *tonight* hoặc *tomorrow* và xem lại câu hỏi.
example: I *usually* walk to school. *Today* I'm taking the bus.
It's *usually* at four. *Today* it's at five.

items.en: People *change their mind*. Listen for the new choice after words like *so*, *then* and *I'll*.
items.vi: Mọi người hay đổi ý. Hãy nghe lựa chọn mới sau những từ như *so*, *then* và *I'll*.
example: I want carrots. Hmm... *I'll* grow cress.
There isn't any juice? *Then* milk, please.

items.en: Clock words: *o'clock* = :00, *half past* = :30, *quarter past* = :15, *quarter to* = 15 minutes before the hour.
items.vi: Từ chỉ giờ: *o'clock* = giờ đúng, *half past* = 30 phút, *quarter past* = 15 phút, *quarter to* = kém 15 phút.

items.en: Part 3 form: when a name is *spelled*, write every letter. A phone number is said one number at a time.
items.vi: Phần 3 điền phiếu: khi một cái tên được đánh vần, hãy viết từng chữ cái. Số điện thoại được đọc từng số một.
example: five three eight two nine four one = *538 2941*

check.sentence: In Part 1, you hear {all three|only one|none} of the pictures.
"Is it a cat?" "No, it's a rabbit." The answer is a {rabbit|cat|dog}.
"I usually walk, but today I'm going by bus." Today: {bus|walk|car}.
"I want juice. Oh, there isn't any? Then milk, please." The child has {milk|juice|water}.
